It analyses lib 70b02c7 (promote 0.9675, 'converges in ~0.15 s and leaves ~90% of the 2 s budget unused'), but the champion is 0406f12: a k-hop skeleton construction with randomized restarts plus a raise search that uses ~1.45 s of the 2 s budget (measured 1.44-1.45 s on 0000/0004/0012) and scores promote 0.
proposals.plan:
Incumbent: variant v0 (lib commit 70b02c7) is a monolithic solver: a multi-config greedy 'trunk' construction (weighted dominating-set targets, farthest-point roots, top-down trunk layers, leftovers attached BFS-style), then a deterministic subtree-reparent hill climb. It reaches promote mean g = 0.9675 / holdout 0.9665 but converges in ~0.15 s and prints once, leaving ~90% of the 2 s budget unused. K (~513k) is a best-known reference value, not an optimum, so there is headroom.

TARGET: the champion is lib 4fa538b (promote mean 0.99859, hold-out 0.99751). This proposal is a decomposition of that exact solver, not of an older one.

STUB STRENGTH (measured, local 1-core 2 s, 30 promote instances): the glue + four stubs (champion pipeline split into construct/search; lns and skeleton are identity/no-op) scores mean g 0.9982-0.9989 over repeated runs (iteration count is wall-clock dependent), i.e. at the champion's 0.9986. The variant therefore starts AT champion strength;

TARGET: champion lib 4fa538b (promote mean 0.998587, hold-out 0.99751) -- an AHC041 solver: N=1000 Delaunay graph, weights A in [1,100], H=10, maximize 1 + sum A[v]*(h[v]+1) with h[v] > 0 requiring a neighbour at h[v]-1.

STUB STRENGTH (measured on this desk, one pinned core, AHC_INSTANCE_SECONDS=2, SEED=1, 6 promote-style instances): glue + the four stubs scores 513215 / 501416 / 518299 / 503415 / 503606 / 498351 against the champion binary's 512743 / 502523 / 517473 / 501360 / 503860 / 498492

proposals.plan: TARGET. Champion lib 4fa538b (promote mean g 0.99859, hold-out 0.99751). The promote gate needs a +0.002 mean gain while only 0.00141 g of headroom to the best-known K remains, so a solution that merely approaches K cannot land: the tree has to beat K on average. Every recent v0.app probe stalled just under the gate (+0.0012, +0.0014, +0.0015, +0.0016, +0.0019) and they were all single pipeline tweaks (lazy-greedy speed-up, wider prefix ratchet, budget 0.76/0.82, skip-polish) submitted alone. ARCHITECTURE: two broad bundles, not a pipeline split.
- engine (app/engine): one complete contender. The champion's whole restart pipeline (top-down k-hop construction, restart/selection policy, monotone local search) lives in this directory behind one entry point, engine::run(in, incumbent, seed, deadline, out).
- trunk (app/trunk): a monotone structural reviser. It takes one solution, keeps its shallow levels < d0, rebuilds everything above, and returns it only if the whole score improved.
